senses.gloss: m. (cera, κηρός) wax. Targ. II Esth. III, 8 (not קיר).—
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 40a:18">B. Mets. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>באתריה … בק׳ וכ׳</he> in the place of one of the differing teachers they line the barrels with wax, which does not absorb much &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:13">Snh. 95ᵃ</cite> (proverbial phrase) <he>בר ברך ק׳ וכ׳</he> let thy grandson sell wax (be a poor man), so that thou be spared suffering (do not sacrifice the present for the sake of the future); a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="S01178"><he>קִירֵי</he></cite>.
